journal_name: The Review of Economics and Statistics

articles.title_en: Fear and the Safety Net: Evidence from Secure Communities
articles.title_cn: 恐惧与安全网：来自安全社区的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of Secure Communities, an immigration enforcement program that dramatically increased interior removals of Hispanic noncitizens from the United States, on participation in means-tested social insurance programs among co-ethnic citizens. Exploiting county-level variation in the roll-out of enforcement together with its ethnic specificity, we find that Hispanic-headed citizen households significantly reduced their participation in two large federal safety net programs. Our results are most consistent with network effects that propagate fear through minority communities rather than stigma or lack of benefit information.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了安全社区计划的效果，该移民执法计划大幅增加了美国境内对西班牙裔非公民的遣返，对同族裔公民参与经济状况调查型社会保险计划的影响。利用县级执法推广的差异及其族裔特定性，我们发现西班牙裔户主的公民家庭显著减少了对两个大型联邦安全网计划的参与。我们的结果最符合通过少数族裔社区传播恐惧的网络效应，而非污名化或缺乏福利信息。

articles.title_en: The Local Economic Impacts of Prisons
articles.abstract_en: I examine the economic consequences of prisons on local communities using two complementary approaches. The first uses prison openings during the 1990s across the United States, and the second exploits the results of the prison site-selection competitions in Texas. Prisons bring substantial and persistent gains in public employment. However, additional jobs at the prisons generate little spillover effects on private sector employment and fail to provide a major boost to local economic activity—overall resulting in approximately a one-for-one increase in local employment. Neighborhoods closest to prisons also experience declines in housing values and demographic shifts toward low-socioeconomic status households.
articles.abstract_cn: 我使用两种互补的方法考察监狱对当地社区的经济后果。第一种利用1990年代美国各地的监狱开设，第二种利用得克萨斯州监狱选址竞争的结果。监狱带来公共就业的显著且持续的增长。然而，监狱新增的就业岗位对私营部门就业产生的溢出效应很小，未能对当地经济活动提供重大推动——总体上导致当地就业大约一对一地增加。离监狱最近的社区还经历了住房价值下降和向低社会经济地位家庭的人口结构转变。

articles.title_en: The Political Economy of Immigration Enforcement: Conflict and Cooperation under Federalism
articles.title_cn: 移民执法的政治经济学：联邦制下的冲突与合作
articles.abstract_en: Selection forces often confound the effects of policy changes. In the immigration enforcement context, we tackle this challenge tracking arrested immigrants along the deportation pipeline, isolating local and federal efforts. 80% of counties exhibit strategic substitutabilities in responding to federal enforcement, while the federal level is very effective at directing its efforts toward cooperative counties. We estimate that changes in the profile of immigration cases, and not weakened federal efforts, drove the reduction in deportations following a 2011 shift in federal priorities. Reducing immigration-court discretion and removing their dependence from the executive would have a significant impact on deportations.
articles.abstract_cn: 选择力量常常混淆政策变化的影响。在移民执法背景下，我们通过追踪被捕移民在遣返流程中的路径，隔离地方和联邦的努力来应对这一挑战。80%的县在对联邦执法作出反应时表现出战略替代性，而联邦层面在将努力导向合作县方面非常有效。我们估计，移民案件构成的变化，而非联邦努力的减弱，推动了2011年联邦优先事项转变后遣返数量的减少。减少移民法庭的自由裁量权并使其摆脱对行政部门的依赖，将对遣返产生显著影响。

articles.title_en: Worker Earnings, Service Quality, and Firm Profitability: Evidence from Nursing Homes and Minimum Wage Reforms
articles.title_cn: 工人收入、服务质量与企业盈利能力：来自养老院和最低工资改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines whether higher earnings for frontline workers affects the quality of employees’ output. I leverage increases in the statutory minimum wage, combined with worker, consumer, and firm outcomes in the nursing home sector. I find that higher minimum wages increase income and retention among low-wage employees and improve consumer outcomes, measured by fewer inspection violations; lower rates of adverse, preventable health conditions; and lower resident mortality. Firms maintain profitability by attracting consumers with a greater ability to pay and increasing prices for these individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了一线工人收入提高是否会影响员工产出质量。我利用法定最低工资的上调，结合养老院行业的工人、消费者和企业结果。我发现，最低工资的提高增加了低收入员工的收入和留任率，并改善了消费者结果，表现为检查违规减少；不良、可预防的健康状况发生率降低；以及居民死亡率下降。企业通过吸引支付能力更强的消费者并提高这些人的价格来维持盈利能力。

articles.title_en: The Causal Effects of R&D Grants: Evidence from a Regression Discontinuity
articles.title_cn: 研发资助的因果效应：来自断点回归的证据
articles.abstract_en: We leverage the discontinuity in the assignment mechanism of the Small and Medium Enterprise Instrument—the first European research and development (R&D) subsidy targeting small firms—to provide the broadest quasi-experimental evidence on R&D grants over both geographical and sectoral scopes. Grants trigger sizable impacts on a wide range of firm-level outcomes. Heterogeneous effects are consistent with grants reducing financial frictions. This reduction is due to funding rather than certification. We also provide direct causal evidence on pure certification—signaling not attached to funding—and show that firms that only receive “quality stamps” do not improve their performance. Finally, our estimates suggest that the scheme produces private returns that are positive and comparable to those of the U.S. Small Business Innovation Research program, while also generating geographical and sectoral spillovers in the form of increased rates of entrepreneurial entry.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用中小企业工具——欧洲首个针对小企业的研发补贴——的分配机制中的断点，提供了在地理和部门范围内最广泛的关于研发资助的准实验证据。资助对一系列企业层面的结果产生了显著影响。异质性效应与资助减少金融摩擦相一致。这种减少是由于资金而非认证。我们还提供了关于纯粹认证——即不附带资金的信号——的直接因果证据，并表明仅获得“质量印章”的企业并未改善其绩效。最后，我们的估计表明，该计划产生的私人回报为正，且与美国小企业创新研究计划相当，同时以创业进入率提高的形式产生地理和部门溢出效应。

articles.title_en: Licensing Life-Saving Drugs for Developing Countries: Evidence from the Medicines Patent Pool
articles.title_cn: 为发展中国家许可救命药物：来自药品专利池的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study the effects of the Medicines Patent Pool (MPP)—an institution that pools patents across geographical markets—on the licensing and adoption of life-saving drugs in low- and middle-income countries. We show the presence of an immediate and large increase in licensing when a patent is included in the MPP. We also show evidence that the pool increases actual entry and volume of sales, but these impacts are much smaller than on licensing, which is due to the geographic bundling of licenses. The paper highlights the potential of pools in promoting diffusion of biomedical innovation in developing countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了药品专利池（MPP）——一个跨地理市场汇集专利的机构——对低收入和中等收入国家救命药物的许可和采用的影响。我们表明，当一项专利被纳入MPP时，许可立即大幅增加。我们还证明，该专利池增加了实际进入和销售量，但这些影响远小于对许可的影响，这是由于许可的地理捆绑。本文强调了专利池在促进发展中国家生物医学创新传播方面的潜力。

articles.title_en: Measuring Preferences for Income Equality and Income Mobility
articles.title_cn: 衡量对收入平等和收入流动性的偏好
articles.abstract_en: This paper quantifies preferences for income equality and mobility by generating statistics that are uncorrelated with beliefs and can be interpreted as marginal rates of substitution (MRS). All things being equal, U.S. residents are willing to reduce average income by $2,744 to reduce the 90/10 income inequality ratio one unit, and $1,228 to increase income mobility from the bottom quintile one percentage point. Democrats and Independents have similar preferences for both social variables, while Republicans have an MRS that is about two-thirds that of Democrats and Independents for both income inequality and mobility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过生成与信念无关且可解释为边际替代率（MRS）的统计量，量化了对收入平等和流动性的偏好。在其他条件相同的情况下，美国居民愿意将平均收入减少2,744美元，以将90/10收入不平等比率降低一个单位，并愿意减少1,228美元，以将收入流动性从最底层五分之一提高一个百分点。民主党人和独立人士对这两个社会变量的偏好相似，而共和党人的边际替代率约为民主党人和独立人士对收入不平等和流动性的三分之二。

articles.title_en: Air Pollution and the Labor Market: Evidence from Wildfire Smoke
articles.title_cn: 空气污染与劳动力市场：来自野火烟雾的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study how air pollution impacts the U.S. labor market by analyzing the effects of drifting wildfire smoke. We link satellite-based smoke plume data with labor market outcomes to estimate that an additional day of smoke exposure reduces quarterly earnings by about 0.1%. Extensive margin responses, including employment reductions and labor force exits, explain 13% of the overall earnings losses. The implied welfare costs from lost earnings due to air pollution exposure is on par with standard valuations of the mortality burden. The findings highlight the importance of labor market channels in air pollution policy responses.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过分析飘移野火烟雾的影响来研究空气污染如何影响美国劳动力市场。我们将基于卫星的烟雾羽流数据与劳动力市场结果联系起来，估计额外一天的烟雾暴露会使季度收入减少约0.1%。包括就业减少和劳动力退出在内的广泛边际反应解释了总体收入损失的13%。因空气污染暴露导致的收入损失所隐含的福利成本与标准死亡率负担估值相当。研究结果强调了劳动力市场渠道在空气污染政策应对中的重要性。

articles.title_en: The Impacts of the U.S. Trade War on Chinese Exporters
articles.title_cn: 美国贸易战对中国出口商的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the impacts of the 2018 U.S. tariff surges on export prices and adjustments of sales across different markets of Chinese exporters. The finding that U.S. tariffs did not affect the free-on-board price of Chinese exports is robust to controlling for firm-related fixed effects. While firms’ exports to the United States dropped significantly, exports to the EU increased moderately and domestic sales or exports to other foreign markets were barely affected. Finally, by surveying managers of exporting firms, we shed light on potential impediments to firms’ adjustments of export prices and sales.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2018年美国关税激增对中国出口商出口价格和跨市场销售调整的影响。在控制企业相关固定效应后，美国关税未影响中国出口的离岸价格的发现是稳健的。尽管企业对美国的出口大幅下降，但对欧盟的出口适度增加，而国内销售或对其他外国市场的出口几乎未受影响。最后，通过调查出口企业的经理，我们揭示了企业调整出口价格和销售的潜在障碍。

articles.title_en: The Price of Inclusion: Evidence from Housing Developer Behavior
articles.title_cn: 包容的代价：来自住房开发商行为的证据
articles.abstract_en: In many cities, incentives and regulations lead developers to integrate low-income housing into market-rate buildings. How cost-effective are these policies? I study take-up of a tax incentive in New York City using a model in which developers trade off between tax savings and pretax income. Estimating the model using policy variation and microdata on development from 2003 to 2015, I find a citywide marginal fiscal cost of $1.6 million per low-income unit. Differences in neighborhoods, not developer incidence, explain the cost premium over other housing programs. Weighing costs against estimates of neighborhood effects, I conclude middle-class neighborhoods offer “opportunity bargains.”
articles.abstract_cn: 在许多城市，激励措施和法规促使开发商将低收入住房融入市场价建筑中。这些政策的成本效益如何？我利用一个模型研究了纽约市税收激励的采纳情况，在该模型中，开发商在税收节省和税前收入之间进行权衡。利用政策变化和2003年至2015年开发的微观数据估计模型，我发现全市每套低收入单元的边缘财政成本为1.6万美元。社区差异，而非开发商负担，解释了与其他住房项目相比的成本溢价。将成本与邻里效应的估计值进行权衡，我得出结论，中产阶级社区提供了“机会廉价品”。

articles.title_en: A Cold Shower for the Hot Hand Fallacy: Robust Evidence from Controlled Settings
articles.title_cn: 热手谬误的冷水澡：来自受控环境的稳健证据
articles.abstract_en: The canonical hot hand fallacy result was recently reversed, based largely on a single statistic, and a data set that was underpowered for individual-level testing. Here we perform a more robust analysis, testing whether hot hand performance exists across (i) data sets: four different controlled shooting experiments, (ii) time: multiple sessions per individual spread across a six month gap, and (iii) various (improved) approaches to statistical testing. We find strong evidence of hot hand performance, both across data sets and within individuals across time. Moreover, in a study of beliefs, we find that expert observers can successfully predict which shooters get the hottest.
articles.abstract_cn: 经典的热手谬误结果最近被推翻，主要基于单一统计量，以及一个在个体层面检验上功效不足的数据集。在此，我们进行更稳健的分析，检验热手表现是否存在于（i）数据集：四个不同的受控投篮实验，（ii）时间：个体在六个月间隔内多次会话，以及（iii）各种（改进的）统计检验方法。我们发现热手表现的强有力证据，既跨数据集，也跨时间在个体内部。此外，在一项信念研究中，我们发现专家观察者能够成功预测哪些射手最热。

articles.title_en: Measuring Under- and Overreaction in Expectation Formation
articles.title_cn: 衡量预期形成中的反应不足与反应过度
articles.abstract_en: We develop a framework for measuring under- and overreaction in expectation formation. The basic insight is that under- and overreaction to new information is identified (up to sign) by the impulse response function of forecast errors. Our measurement procedure yields estimates of under- and overreaction to different shocks at various horizons. In an application to inflation expectations, we find that forecasters underreact to aggregate shocks but overreact to idiosyncratic shocks. We illustrate how our approach can be used to (i) quantify the importance of different biases, (ii) estimate theoretical models, and (iii) shed light on existing empirical approaches and puzzles.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们开发了一个框架来衡量预期形成中的反应不足与反应过度。基本见解是，对新信息的反应不足与反应过度（符号上）由预测误差的脉冲响应函数识别。我们的测量程序能够估计在不同时间范围内对不同冲击的反应不足与反应过度。在应用于通胀预期的案例中，我们发现预测者对总体冲击反应不足，但对特质冲击反应过度。我们展示了我们的方法如何用于（i）量化不同偏差的重要性，（ii）估计理论模型，以及（iii）阐明现有的实证方法和谜题。

articles.title_en: Regulated Revenues and Hospital Behavior: Evidence from a Medicare Overhaul
articles.title_cn: 受监管收入与医院行为：来自医疗保险改革的证据
articles.abstract_en: We study a 2008 policy reform in which Medicare revised its hospital payment system to better reflect patients’ severity of illness. We construct a simulated instrument that predicts a hospital’s policy-induced change in reimbursement using pre-reform patients and postreform rules. The reform led to large persistent changes in Medicare payment rates across hospitals. Hospitals that faced larger gains in Medicare reimbursement increased the volume of Medicare patients they treated. The estimates imply a volume elasticity of 1.2. To accommodate greater volume, hospitals increased nurse employment, but also lowered length of stay.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了一项2008年的政策改革，其中医疗保险修订了其医院支付系统，以更好地反映患者的疾病严重程度。我们构建了一个模拟工具，利用改革前的患者和改革后的规则来预测医院因政策引起的报销变化。该改革导致各医院医疗保险支付率发生了巨大且持久的变化。面临医疗保险报销收益较大增加的医院增加了其治疗的医疗保险患者数量。估计结果暗示数量弹性为1.2。为了容纳更大的患者量，医院增加了护士雇佣，但也缩短了住院时间。
